summary: Comprehensive testing of Ticket System (P0 bug fix) and Yeastar PBX integration (new feature). All 23 backend API tests pass. All frontend UI flows work correctly - tickets are clickable, notes/emails work, status changes work, Yeastar PBX pages load with all tabs functional.
passed_tests: GET /api/tickets - returns ticket list with all required fields
GET /api/tickets/{id} - returns single ticket details
POST /api/tickets - creates new ticket with ticket_number
PUT /api/tickets/{id} - updates ticket status
GET /api/tickets/{id}/comments - returns ticket comments
POST /api/tickets/{id}/comments - creates comment/note
POST /api/tickets/{id}/comments (is_internal=true) - creates internal note
GET /api/tickets/{id}/emails - returns ticket emails
POST /api/tickets/{id}/emails - sends email (MOCKED)
PUT /api/users/{id} - updates user email signature
GET /api/yeastar/status - returns configuration status
GET /api/yeastar/dashboard - returns dashboard stats (18/24 extensions, 3 active calls, etc.)
GET /api/yeastar/extensions - returns 6 extensions with status, device, IP
GET /api/yeastar/active-calls - returns 3 active calls with direction, status, duration
GET /api/yeastar/call-logs - returns 8 call log entries
GET /api/yeastar/system-info - returns PBX info (hostname, firmware, capacity)
GET /api/yeastar/settings - returns settings (without client_secret)
POST /api/yeastar/settings - saves PBX settings
GET /api/yeastar/test-connection - tests connection
UI: Tickets list shows all columns (Ticket, Client, Priority, Status, Assigned, Created)
UI: Clicking ticket row opens detail view
UI: Ticket detail shows Description, Notes & Activity, Email Signature sections
UI: Add Note button works - note appears in activity feed
UI: Send Email dialog opens with signature preview
UI: Email sent shows in activity feed (MOCKED - not actually delivered)
UI: Save Signature button saves email signature
UI: Status dropdown changes ticket status
UI: Back arrow returns to ticket list
UI: New Ticket dialog opens with all form fields
UI: Yeastar PBX page loads at /yeastar
UI: Yeastar shows 4 dashboard stats (Extensions Online, Active Calls, Calls Today, Missed Today)
UI: Yeastar Extensions tab shows extension list with all columns
UI: Yeastar Active Calls tab shows active calls with direction icons
UI: Yeastar Call Logs tab shows call history with status badges
UI: Yeastar System Info tab shows PBX Information and Capacity
UI: Yeastar Settings dialog opens with PBX URL, Client ID, Client Secret fields
UI: Yeastar PBX appears in sidebar under INTEGRATIONS group
